bctc_reparse_job_status.note: Job runs daily as scheduled. 3 stranded feedback rows exist (EIB, FPT, DHG Q1-2026) with reparse_attempts=2 each — extraction failed twice. Root cause: pdftoppm + tesseract both MISSING from container, and all 3 Q1-2026 PDFs are image-based (not text-native). pdf-parse tier returns <100 chars, OCR cache is empty, DPI-300 retry cannot run without pdftoppm. bctcReparseJob correctly escalated to attempts=2 but cannot resolve without OCR toolchain.

bctc_pdf_pull_job_status.critical_bug: bctcPdfPullJob only processes rows WHERE source_url LIKE 'http://125.212.251.27:8765/bctc-files/%'. The 34 pending Q1-2026 rows have staticfile.hsx.vn SSC portal URLs — these are NEVER picked up. The job runs every 30 min and returns 0 downloads every time. This is the primary blocker for 34 of 43 pending queue rows.

bctc_queue_enricher_status.note: Enricher correctly targets rows WHERE source_url IS NULL. The 34 rows with SSC portal URLs already have source_url populated — enricher skips them (correct behavior). The 9 rows with NULL source_url ARE being processed by enricher but result in 0 enriched (VPS not responding for those tickers, or geo-blocked).

blocker_detail: Two independent blockers compounding: (1) ARCHITECTURE GAP — bctcPdfPullJob only pulls rows with VPS-format URLs (http://125.212.251.27:8765/bctc-files/...). 34 pending Q1-2026 rows have SSC portal URLs (staticfile.hsx.vn). No job is wired to download from SSC portal directly. These rows have been idle for 19 days with attempts=0. The VPS must cache these files first (ops scope) OR the pull job needs to also handle SSC portal URLs directly. (2) OCR TOOLCHAIN MISSING — pdftoppm and tesseract absent from mcp-server container. The 4 PDFs already pulled (GAS/FPT/EIB/DHG Q1-2026) are all image-based. Without OCR tools, extraction always fails. Q4-2025 succeeded because those were text-native (pdf-parse path).
secondary_blockers: bctcBatchSweep never ran (no cron_job_runs record) — would have bulk-queued Q1-2026 via VPS
9 queue rows have null source_url — queueEnricher cannot discover SSC URL (likely geo-blocked from host or VPS not serving those tickers)
28 Q4-2025 rows marked url_not_found — VPS never had those files either
remediation_target: OPS: ensure VPS caches all 34 SSC-URL PDFs at /bctc-files/ so bctcPdfPullJob can pick them up; AND ops/mcp-server Dockerfile must re-add poppler-utils + tesseract-ocr to container for image PDF extraction

bugs_to_flag_to_po.description: 34 pending rows with valid staticfile.hsx.vn URLs have been idle 19 days. bctcPdfPullJob only queries WHERE source_url LIKE 'http://125.212.251.27:8765/bctc-files/%'. If the VPS cannot reach SSC (geo-block from VPS side is ops scope), these rows will never clear without a code change to also download from SSC URLs directly.
